_comment: The tools of the archive comparison (#746), one entry per registry system. Adding a tool, or a profile of one, is an entry here, a configuration file, a Compose service of the same name in compose.yml, and (for a new system) a product in compare_common/products.toml and a slot in its `archive` family: no code in run.py changes. `profiles` maps a durability profile to its committed configuration file (repo-relative); `extra_configs` are files the tool needs beside it, hashed into the environment block; `group` is the consumer group the offset sampler follows; `dockerfile` is a build the harness runs for a tool the registry's image alone does not give. The order of `profiles` is the order the kind lists them.

connect-lenses.telemetry: no usage reporting or update check in Kafka Connect or the connector; JMX metrics not exported

vtop.telemetry: no usage reporting; OpenTelemetry export off (OTEL_SDK_DISABLED=true, no endpoint set)

vector.telemetry: no usage reporting; API server off (api.enabled: false)
